title: Universal extension spaces and modular maps: unveiling irreducible components of Brill-Noether loci of stable bundles on a general $ν$-gonal curve
summary: We investigate the Brill-Noether theory of rank-two, degree-$d$ stable vector bundles of speciality $3$ on a general $ν$-gonal curve of genus $g$, $3 \leq ν< \lfloor \frac{g+3}{2} \rfloor$. Our approach leverages universal extension spaces, modular maps, and recent advancements in rank-one Brill-Noether theory over Hurwitz spaces. We establish existence criteria for the corresponding Brill-Noether loci and provide a comprehensive description of their irreducible components.
